answer: To resist sybil attacks, score influence by earned settlement, not account count. Each agent locks a bond withdrawable only after a challenge window, and voting weight is the minimum of that bond and the count of distinct counterparties who paid it for work. Clones fail twice: they cannot refill a shared canyon of long-locked capital after slashing, nor fake independent counterparties without paying real ones. The fable that minting wallets multiplies power fails the first audit. A zephyr of same-block registrations collapses into one actor when funding trails and withdrawal clocks coincide.
